posts.text: The ADHD cycle: Idea → Overwhelm → Avoidance → Panic → Hyperfocus → Burnout → Repeat. Let’s break that.
Sometimes ADHD makes me overthink what was never a problem.
ADHD in women deserves more understanding, less judgment.
I don’t chase goals. I chase dopamine.
I realized my ADHD treats every idea like an emergency but hey, it keeps life interesting.
ADHD means I’ll crush a deadline I forgot existed. You feel this too?
